Vacancy for Staff
Friday, 25 August 2023

Dean invites applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience for the below mentioned posts; which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
16/9/2023
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory, copy of the same to be submitted along with application for Serial No.3, 4 and 5
.
Tutor:
Qualification : MBBS / M.Sc.
in Medical Microbiology, Medical Anatomy, Medical Physiology, Medical Biochemistry from a recognized Institute.
Research Assistant / Scientific Officer
: 1
post
Qualification
&
Experience:
Postgraduate in Life sciences (Genetics/Biotechnology Molecular Biology / Human Genetics / Immunology) with Ph.D. in the areas of Human Genetics /Medical Genetics / Biotechnology / Genetic Diseases Diagnosis from an Indian University / Institute or a foreign University / Institute recognized by UGC. Minimum 2 years diagnostic experience or Research experience in cytogenetic and molecular cytogenetic including chromosome analysis using techniques like Fluorescence in situ Hybridization (FISH) and knowledge of molecular biology techniques such as PCR, sequencing, fluorescence microscopy. Preference will be given to those possessing publications in the related field in index journals as first / corresponding author.
Accountant :
Qualification
&
Experience:
Graduation in Commerce from recognized University in India
or equivalent, proficiency in operating the computerized system and should have dealt with the maintenance of Books of Accounts like cash book, ledger, journal, stock-books and the process of scrutiny of bills and pay bills, drawing salaries, should have adequate knowledge about Income Tax Laws, Provident Fund, Professional Tax, etc. He/She should also have knowledge of preparing a budget, drawing the profit/ loss accounts, balance sheet, etc. with experience of 5 years or more in and organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above.
Cashier
Qualification
&
Experience:
Degree in Commerce from a recognized University or equivalent, proficiency in computer applications with at least 2 years’ experience as Cashier in a Medical College or 500 beded hospital.
C.T./MRI Technician
Qualification
&
Experience:
B.Sc. in Medical Radiography and Imaging Technology. M.Sc. in Medical Imaging Technology will be preferred, must have 5 years’ experience in CT, MRI, Radiography in 500 beded hospital.  MSCIT with proficiency in operating computer.
Salary            :
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
: Post of
Tutors
are tenure post for maximum 3 years on consolidated salary.
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.  Experience can be relaxed for exceptionally good candidate.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
